verdict: NOT 10/10. Release candidate V4.0.10; V4.1.0 withheld.

gates.gate: Font Bakery universal + Google Fonts profiles: 0 FAIL
gates.evidence: fontbakery not installed and no network in the build sandbox. tools/run_checks.py::check_metadata is a small own subset, not a substitute.

gates.gate: Pri-African coverage + language shaping (Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo)
gates.evidence: coverage sets complete in 3 masters; 192 NFC/NFD/reversed-mark render comparisons, 0 failures (Chromium).

gates.gate: Latin Core coverage (official 324-glyph list)
gates.evidence: official Core letters: 219/219 present in all 3 masters (source: googlefonts/glyphsets 0.6.19). NOT verified: the 104 non-letter Core glyphs (list not retrievable offline) and the unencoded /idotaccent glyph (absent).

gates.gate: Tabular figures equal width; no .notdef for required characters
gates.evidence: static + 7 variable instances equal; no cmap entry maps to .notdef.

gates.gate: Clean-clone build reproduces recorded SHA-256
gates.evidence: 28/28 font files identical from a clean copy of the inputs (checked under two PYTHONHASHSEED values). Run inside the same sandbox, not on a separate machine/CI.

gates.gate: Variable and static agree within 1 unit
gates.evidence: max coordinate delta 0.5 units at 400/500/600; advances identical.

gates.gate: Advance widths identical across Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, native apps
gates.evidence: Chromium only: TTF/WOFF/WOFF2/variable agree (max delta 0.000 px); DPR 1-3, dark, forced-colours, 200% zoom/text agree (0.008 px). Firefox, WebKit, iOS, Android not run.

gates.gate: OFL text and copyright intact
gates.evidence: fonts/OFL.txt + name IDs 0/13/14 verified.

gates.gate: Name clearance recorded
gates.evidence: NAME_CLEARANCE.md: an established DeFi protocol named Synthetix exists (web search). Trademark/domain registries were not searched. Owner decision pending.

gates.gate: Zero open critical defects
gates.evidence: Open: name collision (critical for any public release), Q tail, J/K/R/a/C/G shape gaps, rn~m confusable, variable latin subset over budget. See V4_REPORT.md.

gates.gate: Shape similarity >= 0.85 on >= 90% of Match glyphs
gates.evidence: V3 recorded raw IoU: 31/52 = 59.6% >= 0.85. The outlines are byte-identical in V4 (regression ledger), so the recorded values carry over. Reference bitmaps are absent: cannot re-measure.

gates.gate: Widths within 1 px for >= 90%
Held-out pair gaps within 1 px for >= 90%
gates.evidence: 40/49 = 81.6%; NOT held out (V3 fitted on the same pairs), so this is an upper bound.

gates.gate: Vertical metrics all within 1 px
gates.evidence: 8/9; failing: ['Q below baseline']

gates.gate: Stems within 5% in all four weights from real references
gates.evidence: Regular 9/11 (HIGH targets). Medium/SemiBold targets are inferred; no Bold exists; no heavier references. Cannot be met without new references.

gates.gate: Small-size confusables (Il1, O0, rn~m at 12-14 px)
gates.evidence: default worst-case Jaccard: {'I~l': 1.0, 'I~1': 0.367, 'l~1': 0.355, 'O~0': 0.492, 'rn~m': 0.75, 'cl~d': 0.512, 'vv~w': 0.467}; with ss13+zero: {'I~l': 0.394, 'I~1': 0.6, 'l~1': 0.387, 'O~0': 0.464, 'rn~m': 0.491, 'cl~d': 0.488, 'vv~w': 0.478}. Pre-registered threshold 0.65. Default fails 2 of 7 pairs; ss13+zero passes 7 of 7.

gates.gate: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast pairs (light + dark)
gates.evidence: 22 pairs, 0 failures. Palette is a placeholder.

gates.gate: Subset byte budgets (registered before first export)
gates.evidence: over budget: ['variable/latin 50344 > 45000']. The variable latin-lite subset (core features + ss13) is 40184 B, within its 45,000 B limit; the owner decides which variable build ships.
